newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Standard in HK$191 mln warrant issue.
newsitem.headline: Asia Standard in HK$191 mln warrant issue.

text.p: Asia Standard International Group Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to place through placing agents 220 million warrants on the company's shares at HK$0.90 each.
Asia Standard said net proceeds from the warrant issue of about HK$191 million would be used as working capital.

The property and investment concern said each warrant would entitle holders the right to subscribe for one new company share at HK$2.00 each between May 27, 1997, and June 30, 1998, subject to adjustment.
The company said a total 220 million new shares, or 11.35 percent of the enlarged share capital, would be issued upon exercise in full of the warrants.
The company's shares resumed trading on Wednesday after a one-day suspension, gaining HK$0.10 to HK$2.70 in early trade.
